note: Where the pinned WowSims transport data came from. mapping.json and kinds.json are byte copies of the website files; ids.json is reduced from the website ids/<edition>.json (spell ids only). The "origin" hashes are those of the website files that were read; "pinned" are the hashes of the copies here (tools/export_wowsims_mapping.py --check fails when they differ).
